thread.title: Amazon to Launch More Alexa-Powered Devices for Homes & Cars

author: Zacks Equity Research
title: Amazon to Launch More Alexa-Powered Devices for Homes & Cars

organizations.name: alexa-powered devices for homes & cars amazon.com inc

text:
Amazon.com Inc. AMZN has been witnessing increasing demand for its Alexa-enabled devices. As a result, the e-commerce giant is gearing up to provide new quality products to users. Reportedly, Amazon plans to come up with at least 8 new devices supported by Alexa before the end of the year.
The company has outperformed the industry it belongs to over the past year. Shares of Amazon have gained 100% compared with the industry’s growth of 34%.
Let's discover the new Alexa-powered products
The fast-paced world that we inhabit has created a unique space for digital assistants in our lives, as syncing of these assistants with smart home products makes daily tasks easier and faster.
Apparently, Amazon has been putting in a lot of effort to expand Alexa-powered devices. Also, the rate at which the company is penetrating new markets makes us optimistic.
Reportedly, Amazon plans to come up with new products, namely subwoofer, receiver, car gadget, amplifier, microwave, among others. This growing presence will help Amazon maintain its dominance in the smarthome market. It already holds almost a majority share in this market.
We believe, these new products will allow Amazon to keep customers hooked within its ecosystem of products and services.
Alexa Continues to Gather Steam
Amazon has already made its mark in the personal assistant market, driven by its improving AI skills and machine learning (ML) techniques. Notably, Amazon’s Alexa Skills store now offers more than 45K skills created by third-party developers and also recently introduced new ML learning tools for developers to make the same even more engaging and discoverable.
Moreover, integration of Alexa with smart home speakers is aiding its market shares. All these factors have helped Amazon to gain further momentum in this particular market. According to latest data from Statista, market shares of Alexa came in at 62%, Google Assistant comprised25% while the rest of the voice assistants accounted for 13% of the combined market in 2017.
However, the personal assistant space is at a very competitive stage right now. Therefore companies like Google GOOGL, Apple AAPL, Microsoft MSFT, among others, are strong contenders in the war of capturing consumers’ homes.
Our Take
Technology has brought about a sea change in consumption habits and platforms. Therefore, to keep pace with the change in the digital consumption patterns of books, video, music and gaming, Amazon as well as other leading technology companies like Google and Apple are investing in platforms, content and people to develop suitable technologies.
Amazon’s Echo, Fire TV, Fire TV Stick and other devices’ achievement underscores the fact that Amazon is heading toward the right direction with its Alexa-powered devices. The Alexa-powered devices are going great guns and helping the company to better sellits products and services. The idea is to make Alexa the central point connecting IoT devices used in any household and get unrivaled customer data.
The latest product innovation will definitely take Amazon Prime one step closer to being a must-have living room feature and also in the cars.
